# LeakSanitizer suppressions for the event glue stress test (.github/workflows/nightly.yml).
# Keep this list short: each entry hides real leaks at that site.
#
# libvirt 10.0 (Ubuntu 24.04) creates its object classes once per process, in virOnce
# from virGetConnect, and never frees them: 4 classes and their names, 263 bytes. The
# size does not grow with the number of events. libvirt 11.3 does not report it.
leak:virClassNew
